text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer... there's something I'd like 
you to check over, if you don't mind...

One day before the Osaka Hai, Chrono 
Genesis made that request.
choice_data_list:
Is this to confirm something regarding the 
expedition?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
N-No... um... I-In the school newspaper 
column...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm very sorry to bother you when you're 
busy...! But as a regular reader of ours, 
Trainer... we would love to hear your 
feedback...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I tried writing a column about the Osaka 
Hai...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
If people can understand the drama and 
excitement of racing... perhaps that will 
motivate them to vote in the Grand Prix 
fan ballots...

text_block_list.name: Writer C
text_block_list.text:
"Tokai Teio's Arima Kinen is an 
all-too-famous, legendary race."

text_block_list.name: Writer C
text_block_list.text:
"A comeback drama emblematic of her racing 
career. Her very first resurrection, 
rising time and again like a phoenix, 
was—the Osaka Hai."

text_block_list.name: Writer C
text_block_list.text:
"I feel like I could run all the way to 
the ends of the earth!"―― That famous 
quote came right before the Osaka Hai.

The column touched upon the Osaka Hai, 
where Tokai Teio first returned from 
injury, and chronicled her journey leading 
all the way to the Arima Kinen.

The fans' heartfelt wishes for her 
comeback are captured with such vivid 
realism...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
The fans cast their heartfelt votes and 
shared in the emotion of that miracle... I 
was hoping I could convey that charm...
choice_data_list:
It looks amazing! Why not share it with 
the outside world too?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Huh!? T-To an outsider... you say...?

Those casting votes in the Grand Prix fan 
poll are the fans outside the academy. 
Therefore, this column should be directed 
toward the general public.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: T-True... but how...
choice_data_list: I'll consult with Tracen Academy about it.
I'll consult with Tracen Academy about it.

text_block_list.text:
Many students at the Academy make good use 
of social media. Treating it as an 
expanded version of a school newspaper 
column, it could very well be featured on 
Tracen Academy's official site.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I-I see... I-I'll consult with the PR 
committee too...!
The day of the Osaka Hai.

text_block_list.name: Race Cafe Customer A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you see that column on the Tracen 
Academy website?

text_block_list.name: Race Cafe Customer B
text_block_list.text:
You mean that article about Tokai Teio? I 
read it, I read it! It was super 
interesting!

text_block_list.name: Race Cafe Customer A
text_block_list.text:
I'm definitely looking forward to the 
Osaka Hai now! It used to just be a trial 
race for the Tenno Sho (Spring), but now 
all the top spring middle-distance runners 
gather there, right?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
My column about the Osaka Hai... It seems 
quite a lot of people have been reading 
it...!
choice_data_list:
You could hear it here and there in the 
crowd's chatter, too.

You could hear it here and there in the 
crowd's chatter, too.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I got the impression that interest 
in today's race has also been building 
up...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I want to carry this momentum into the 
Takarazuka Kinen...!
choice_data_list: Let's steadily build upon that foothold!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

Chrono Genesis's rivals today are Lucky 
Lilac, a flower that endures to bloom, and 
Blast Onepiece, an affectionate Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(Those two from Ai-san's generation... 
Each shining with a brilliance no less 
than hers, the leaders of a generation 
packed with champions...)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Chrono-chan, why such a stern look? Are 
ya feelin' nervous?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
A little... since my opponents are two 
people with proven track records.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, the feeling's mutual. If you're all 
tensed up, you won't be able to run 
properly.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
At times like that, taking a deep breath 
really helps! Want to do it together?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
T-Thank you for your concern... I'm 
alright.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Well, rather than nervous—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
If it's just getting into battle-ready 
mode, then that's fine.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (! ...What incredible spirit...!)

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that all! You're totally fired up, 
aren't you?! Then let's have a grand 
showdown!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
I'll show everyone just how fast I've 
gotten! I'm not gonna lose!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Let's both put on a great run.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(I couldn't move... The pressure was too 
overwhelming...)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...I will run my own race...!
